messages:
Kelly: Heads up — staging publish for release/2026.03 failed in eu-west ECR. Manifest pushed but arm64 layer digest didn't match on registry side. Buildbot shows 3/4 layers succeeded, last chunk returned 422. Can we pin the canary to previous digest and retry push?

deploy-bot: [automated] publish attempted for tag release/2026.03-staging @ eu-west; status: PARTIAL_PUSH. See logs: https://logs.internal/build/2245123456 :warning:

buildbot: Upload error snippet: 
```
Uploading layer chunk 4/4 -> HTTP 422
Manifest accepted, but final manifest verification failed: computed sha256=sha256:abcdef... != registry-reported sha256=sha256:123456...
```

Omar: Looks like a partial layer corruption during chunk transfer. Could be transient ECR rate limit or a broken multipart upload. Do we have retries enabled in the publish step?

Kelly: retries are on but we still see the mismatch. I want to avoid sending traffic to a half-published image. My proposal: pin the canary to the prior digest that passed QA, mark the broken publish as "do not promote", and schedule a manual republish during the change window. Thoughts?

Sasha: Agreed. Steps I'd do: 1) pin canary service config to image@sha256:prevdigest 2) create a tracking issue and mark the current artifact as quarantined 3) try a local redispatch of the push from the builder host with `skopeo copy` so we can inspect layer integrity before pushing.

Omar: Commands I used to inspect last time: 
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name mysvc --image-ids imageTag=release/2026.03-staging --region eu-west-1 --output json
skopeo inspect docker://eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/mysvc@sha256:prevdigest
skopeo copy --retry-times=5 docker-daemon:mysvc:staging docker://eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/mysvc@sha256:newdigest
```

Kelly: OK. Immediate actions: @ReleaseManager, can you create the tracking issue and set the change window for 02:00 UTC tonight? We'll pin canary to prevdigest now. Omar/Sasha can run republish during window and update this thread.

ReleaseManager: Creating issue: https://issues.internal/RED-9876 "staging publish partial push - quarantine + republish". Change window set 02:00-03:00 UTC. Adding teams: eng-releases, eng-runtime, infra.

deploy-bot: Action taken: pinned service canary to mysvc@sha256:prevdigest (rollback-style pin). Traffic gradually shifted back to prevdigest. Canary health check: passing.

Sasha: I'll attempt a republish from builder-03 during the window with increased chunk size and skopeo retry. If the same mismatch happens, we'll run an `s3md5` check on the builder's uploaded chunks and check for intermediate network device that might be dropping frames.

Omar: If republish fails again, fallback plan: retag prevdigest to a new canary tag (release/2026.03-staging-replay-<ts>) and promote that image after QA. We should avoid rewriting the existing digest in ECR.

Kelly: Agreed. Also add a short note in release notes: "staging publish temporarily blocked due to partial registry digest mismatch; canary pinned to previous digest while we investigate." I'll keep this thread as the coordination channel.

Sasha: Quick FYI — cosign attestation for the original publish expired yesterday for that builder, double-check signature TTL when republishing so we don't hit an attestation reject.

Omar: Noted. I'll add an env var to the republish job to ensure cosign signs with current key and timestamp.

ReleaseManager: Issue RED-9876 updated with action items and owner assignees. Will notify SOC if we end up needing a cross-account image pull.

Kelly: Thanks everyone. Reopen this thread if the republish during the window goes sideways. If all good, we'll unpin canary and promote after QA pass. :thumbsup:
